formats.name: Private ascent
formats.description: One travelling party with dates, route and mountain rhythm built around that party rather than a scheduled departure.

formats.name: Couple expedition
formats.description: A two-person private climb designed so one shared objective does not erase two different bodies, paces or altitude responses.
operational_questions: what happens if one climber descends

formats.name: Family / adult family
formats.description: A family expedition designed around suitability first, with age, prior trekking, altitude exposure and independent descent decisions considered before itinerary.
formats.regulatory_context: TANAPA regulations state that children under 10 may not climb above 3,700 m. Enkiama suitability can be more conservative than the legal boundary.

formats.name: Small-group departure
formats.description: A fixed date and route with intentionally limited climber numbers so guide attention does not thin as the group grows.

formats.name: Mountain + Tanzania
formats.description: The climb is treated as one chapter of a wider journey, with recovery and onward travel deliberately composed rather than appended automatically.

future_specialist_formats.name: Research / field expedition
future_specialist_formats.note: Publish only when the scientific objective, permits, technical partner and mountain medical plan are defined.

future_specialist_formats.name: Film / production logistics
future_specialist_formats.note: Publish only when permit handling, equipment loads, communications and production support are operationally verified.

future_specialist_formats.name: Charity / institutional climb
future_specialist_formats.note: Publish when fundraising, group governance and mountain operations are defined for the specific departure.
